name: Shannon Estuary
lore: The Shannon Estuary: Connla on the strand, Ceannai on the south road, and Connla's Well in the east, where the river is born. In the old tale Sinann went to the well for the wisdom of the nine hazels and it rose up and drowned her, and her drowning became the river. Now the well is rising again: the sea runs up the river in calm weather, the ants are flooded out of their hills, the drowned walk the strand, and Kaen Kedger's well-callers sing at the standing stones.

chains.title: The Giant Ants
chains.hint: The ants are pouring out of their flooded hills onto the south road...

stages.name: Clear Ant Hills
stages.objective: Clear the ant hills
stages.announce: Salt water has flooded the ant hills from below, and the giant ants are pouring out onto the road. Their queen has come up with them - kill her.
stages.success: You have cleared the ant hills. The Ant Queen of the Shannon comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the ant hills. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Ant Queen of the Shannon
stages.objective: Defeat the Ant Queen of the Shannon
stages.announce: The Ant Queen of the Shannon stands at the ant hills. Bring friends.

boss.name: The Ant Queen of the Shannon

stages.success: The Ant Queen of the Shannon falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Ant Queen of the Shannon slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Giant Ants Hold the Road
stages.objective: Drive the giant ants off the road
stages.announce: With The Giant Ants lost, the giant ants have spread down onto the road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The giant ants are gone from the road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Cormac, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Cormac has come out to set the road right. The giant ants are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The giant ants break and scatter. The road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Cormac falls, and the giant ants take the road back.

chains.title: The Eriu Hunters
chains.hint: Eriu hunting horns on the river - the war-arrow has gone round the clans...

stages.name: Protect Fiachra the Ferryman
stages.objective: Protect Fiachra the Ferryman, who is mending his ferry
stages.announce: The eriu are hunting along the river, and Fiachra the ferryman is stuck mending his boat. Keep them off him.
stages.success: "That's done," says Fiachra the Ferryman. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Fiachra the Ferryman falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Ferry Landing
stages.objective: Clear the ferry landing
stages.announce: They came from the ferry landing. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the ferry landing. The Eriu Huntmaster comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the ferry landing. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Eriu Huntmaster
stages.objective: Defeat the Eriu Huntmaster
stages.announce: The Eriu Huntmaster stands at the ferry landing. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Eriu Huntmaster falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Eriu Huntmaster slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Eriu Henters Hold the Road to Ceannai
stages.objective: Drive the eriu henters off the road to Ceannai
stages.announce: With The Eriu Hunters lost, the eriu henters have spread down onto the road to Ceannai and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The eriu henters are gone from the road to Ceannai. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Aine, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Aine has come out to set the road to Ceannai right. The eriu henters are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Ceannai is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The eriu henters break and scatter. The road to Ceannai is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Aine falls, and the eriu henters take the road back.

chains.title: The Sheerie Ring
chains.hint: Sentinel Ronnat is looking for help in Ceannai.

giver.name: Sentinel Ronnat
giver.greet: Three children followed the sheerie lights into the bog last night. I'm going to the sheerie ring to fetch them back. Will you come? Say when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close - they will have watchers out. With me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back. Give my people a while to rest, then find me again.

stages.name: The Road to Sheerie Ring
stages.objective: Go with Sentinel Ronnat to the sheerie ring
stages.announce: Sentinel Ronnat sets out for the sheerie ring to fetch the lost children home.
stages.success: Sentinel Ronnat reaches the sheerie ring. "There they are. Clear them out!"
stages.fail: Sentinel Ronnat falls on the road. The others carry the body home.

stages.name: Clear Sheerie Ring
stages.objective: Clear the sheerie ring
stages.announce: Clear the sheerie ring!
stages.success: You have cleared the sheerie ring. Queen Aoibheall comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the sheerie ring. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Queen Aoibheall
stages.objective: Defeat Queen Aoibheall
stages.announce: Queen Aoibheall stands at the sheerie ring. Bring friends.
stages.success: Queen Aoibheall falls. Ceannai will hear of this in the taverns tonight.
stages.fail: Queen Aoibheall slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Moss Sheeries Hold the Road
stages.objective: Drive the moss sheeries off the road
stages.announce: With The Sheerie Ring lost, the moss sheeries have spread down onto the road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The moss sheeries are gone from the road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Fiona, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Fiona has come out to set the road right. The moss sheeries are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The moss sheeries break and scatter. The road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Fiona falls, and the moss sheeries take the road back.

chains.title: The Sandmen of the Strand
chains.hint: The sand of the strand is walking, and it tastes of the sea...

stages.name: Clear Strand
stages.objective: Clear the strand
stages.announce: The sandmen have risen along the strand and drag fishermen into the dunes. Break them back into sand.
stages.success: You have cleared the strand. The Tide-Turned comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the strand. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Tide-Turned
stages.objective: Defeat the Tide-Turned
stages.announce: The Tide-Turned stands at the strand. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Tide-Turned falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Tide-Turned slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Sand Crabs Hold the Road to Connla
stages.objective: Drive the sand crabs off the road to Connla
stages.announce: With The Sandmen of the Strand lost, the sand crabs have spread down onto the road to Connla and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The sand crabs are gone from the road to Connla. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Fiona, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Fiona has come out to set the road to Connla right. The sand crabs are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Connla is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The sand crabs break and scatter. The road to Connla is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Fiona falls, and the sand crabs take the road back.

chains.title: The Rising Tide
chains.hint: The river is running backwards past Connla's quay...

stages.name: The Quay
stages.objective: Keep Quay-Warden Sorcha alive while the river floods the docks
stages.announce: The tide is running UP the river in a dead calm, and the drowned are walking out of it onto Connla's quay! Quay-Warden Sorcha won't leave her post.
stages.thanks: "The quay's still ours. Wet, but ours."
stages.success: The water steadies - and a figure in a rotted captain's coat wades up out of the river.
stages.fail: Quay-Warden Sorcha falls, and the river takes the docks.

stages.name: the Drowned Captain
stages.objective: Defeat the Drowned Captain
stages.announce: The Drowned Captain, a hundred years under the river, comes up the quay steps with his crew behind him. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Drowned Captain sinks back into the river, and the tide turns and runs down to the sea where it belongs.
stages.fail: The Drowned Captain takes the quay.

stages.name: The Drowned Hold the Docks
stages.objective: Drive the drowned off Connla's quay
stages.announce: The drowned stand on Connla's quay in the river-water, looking inland. The docks are shut.
stages.success: The docks are clear, and the water goes down.

chains.title: The Toll at Daigean Bridge
chains.hint: Shouting and a chain across the road at Daigean Bridge...

stages.name: The Toll Gang
stages.objective: Break up the runaways' toll gang at the bridge
stages.announce: Connla's runaways have strung a chain across the bridge road above Daigean Bridge and are charging a toll - with cudgels. Break them up!
stages.success: The gang scatters - and the biggest of them shoulders his way out of the toll hut.
stages.fail: The toll gang holds the bridge.

stages.name: Big Donncha
stages.objective: Defeat Big Donncha
stages.announce: Big Donncha, the gang's enforcer, a head taller than anyone in Connla: 'Two coppers to cross. Ten to leave.'
stages.success: Big Donncha sits down in the road and cries. The chain comes down.
stages.fail: Big Donncha keeps the bridge.

stages.name: The Toll Gang Holds the Bridge
stages.objective: Clear the toll gang off Daigean Bridge
stages.announce: The runaways have the bridge, and nobody crosses without paying.
stages.success: The bridge is free.

chains.title: The Hazel Harvest
chains.hint: Nuts are falling out of season under the nine hazels...

stages.name: The Thieves in the Grove
stages.objective: Drive the eriu fisceres out of the hazel grove
stages.announce: The nine hazels are dropping their nuts out of season, and the eriu fisceres are in the grove with sacks! Every nut they take is a little of the well's wisdom gone.
stages.success: The fisceres run - and the oldest hazel shakes itself, and something steps out of the bark.
stages.fail: The fisceres strip the grove bare.

stages.name: the Hazel-Warden
stages.objective: Defeat the Hazel-Warden
stages.announce: The Hazel-Warden, the grove's own guardian, has woken angry and can't tell friend from thief. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Hazel-Warden sinks back into its tree. A few nuts fall into your hands - freely given, this time.
stages.fail: The Hazel-Warden drives everyone out of the grove.

chains.title: The Serpent Upriver
chains.hint: Something huge is moving in the reeds of the south-west shore...

stages.name: Arracht
stages.objective: Hunt down Arracht
stages.announce: Arracht, the great ollipheist, is roaming the south-west shore on its way upriver to the well. It's the worst thing on the estuary - groups, or the strong.
stages.success: Arracht thrashes in the reeds and goes still. The shore is quiet for the first time in a month.
stages.fail: Arracht slides into the river and is gone upstream.

chains.title: The Well Wakes
chains.hint: The standing stones round Connla's Well are glowing...

stages.name: The Singing Stones
stages.objective: Take the three singing stones from the well-callers and hold them together
stages.announce: The eriu well-callers are singing at the standing stones round Connla's Well, and the stones are answering - the water is rising! Take the stones from them: west, south and east, all at once!
stages.success: The last stone falls silent - but the pool heaves, and a great wave stands up out of it in the shape of a woman.
stages.fail: The stones sing on, and the well overflows.

stages.name: the Wave of Sinann
stages.objective: Break the Wave of Sinann
stages.announce: The Wave of Sinann - the drowned river's own herald - comes up the bank. 'Who stopped my singers?' Bring friends.
stages.success: The Wave of Sinann crashes down and runs back into the pool. The water level drops - a little.
stages.fail: The Wave of Sinann floods the glade.

stages.name: The Well Overflows
stages.objective: Drive the well's water back into the pool
stages.announce: Connla's Well has overflowed its stones. Its waters walk the glade as elementals, and the hazels are drowning.
stages.success: The water runs back into the pool. The glade is dry.

chains.title: The Albion Landing
chains.hint: Sails off the north-west coast: Albion ships are putting in!

stages.name: The Landing
stages.objective: Throw the Albion landing party back into the sea
stages.announce: Albion ships are in the bay north of Connla, and their boats are on the beach! The Saltmarsh Company means to dig in - throw them back into the sea before they do!
stages.success: The landing party breaks - and their captain comes ashore himself to rally them.
stages.fail: The Albions are ashore and digging in. They have a beachhead.

stages.name: Captain Edric Saltmarsh
stages.objective: Defeat Captain Edric Saltmarsh
stages.announce: Captain Edric Saltmarsh of Albion wades ashore with his sergeants. 'Hibernia keeps poor watch. We'll have this coast by nightfall.' Bring friends.
stages.success: Captain Saltmarsh goes down in the surf. His men drag him back to the boats, and the sails turn for Albion.
stages.fail: Captain Saltmarsh rallies his men and they dig in on the dunes.

stages.name: The Albion Beachhead
stages.objective: Burn out the Albion beachhead
stages.announce: The Albions hold a fortified camp on the dunes north of Connla, and their patrols are hunting Hibernians on the strand and the north bank. Burn them out!
stages.success: The beachhead burns. The Saltmarsh Company's last boats pull away for Albion.

chains.title: Storm the Eriu War-Camp
chains.hint: The Sentinels are mustering at Ceannai to storm the eriu war-camp.

giver.name: Sentinel-Commander Grainne
giver.greet: Kedger's war-camp holds the eriu woods, and while it stands his well-callers sing every night. Six at least - bots and all - and when you're ready, say [storm the camp].
giver.reply: Sentinels, with me! Through the palisade, down the totems, and Kedger in his longhouse - go!
giver.thanks: The war-camp is ours. The eriu woods are open.
giver.regret: Fall back to Ceannai! We'll come again.

stages.name: The Palisade
stages.objective: Break the palisade gate under the eriu archers
stages.announce: The Sentinels run you up to the palisade! Eriu archers on the platforms - clear the gate!
stages.success: The gate is down. Inside, three clan totems carved with drowned faces, and kedgers chanting at them - every one standing makes the eriu stronger.
stages.fail: The war band is thrown back from the palisade.

stages.name: The Clan Totems
stages.objective: Pull down all three clan totems and hold them together
stages.announce: Three totems - the salmon, the otter and the drowned woman - and kedgers at each. Take all three at once: split up!
stages.success: The last totem cracks and falls. The chanting stops - and from the longhouse, Kaen Kedger roars.
stages.fail: The totems stand. The war band falls back.

stages.name: Kaen Kedger
stages.objective: Defeat Kaen Kedger in his longhouse
stages.announce: Kaen Kedger comes out of his longhouse in his cloak of fish scales, his huscarls round him: 'The river is ours. She promised it to me!'
stages.success: Kaen Kedger falls among his broken totems. The war-camp is the Sentinels' - and already they're raising the banner of Ceannai.
stages.fail: Kedger drives the war band out of his camp.

chains.title: The Clans Strike Back
chains.hint: Eriu horns in the woods: the clans are coming for the war-camp...

stages.name: Hold the Watch-Post
stages.objective: Keep Watch-Warden Cathal alive
stages.announce: Eriu war-bands are coming through the woods for the watch-post! Keep the watch-warden alive and the camp stands.
stages.thanks: They're falling back into the trees. Well held!
stages.success: The eriu break and melt back into the woods. The watch-post stands.
stages.fail: Watch-Warden Cathal falls, and the watch-post with him.

chains.title: The Second Raid
chains.hint: More eriu horns this time - they mean to take the camp back...

stages.name: Hold the Watch-Post
stages.objective: Keep Watch-Warden Cathal alive
stages.announce: Eriu war-bands are coming through the woods for the watch-post! Keep the watch-warden alive and the camp stands.
stages.thanks: They're falling back into the trees. Well held!
stages.success: The eriu break and melt back into the woods. The watch-post stands.
stages.fail: Watch-Warden Cathal falls, and the watch-post with him.

chains.title: The Drowned-Speaker
chains.hint: Every eriu clan has answered the drowned-speaker's call. They're coming for the camp.

stages.name: Every Clan at Once
stages.objective: Keep Watch-Warden Cathal alive against the whole eriu host
stages.announce: They come from every side of the woods at once. Hold the watch-post!
stages.success: The first rush breaks - and the clans' new war-chief walks out of the trees, dripping.
stages.fail: The watch-post is overrun.

stages.name: Bodhmall the Drowned-Speaker
stages.objective: Defeat Bodhmall the Drowned-Speaker
stages.announce: Bodhmall the Drowned-Speaker, Kedger's chief well-caller, with river-water running from her mouth when she speaks: 'Sinann chose me now. The camp is hers.'
stages.success: Bodhmall falls. The camp holds - for now.
stages.fail: Bodhmall takes the war-camp back for the clans.

siege.name: the Eriu War-Camp
siege.open_text: Hear me! Ceannai's resolve is high - the eriu war-camp can be taken! Sentinel-Commander Grainne is mustering a war band at Ceannai. If no one leads them within the half-hour, the Sentinels will go without you.
siege.taken_text: The eriu war-camp is ours! The Sentinels hold it, and the eriu woods are open - go and see.
siege.repelled_text: The attack on the eriu war-camp has been thrown back. The clans grow bolder.
siege.raid_text: Eriu war-bands are making for the war-camp watch-post!
siege.held_text: The eriu raid is beaten off. The watch-post stands.
siege.fall_text: The war-camp has fallen. The eriu clans hold it again, and Ceannai must rebuild its resolve.
siege.carry_text: The Sentinels march you up through the woods to the war-camp at a run.
siege.carried_cry: The war band wouldn't wait any longer - the Sentinels have stormed {0}!

camp_npcs.name: Quartermaster Ailbhe
camp_npcs.greet: Camp-only stock, for those who took the war-camp and those who hold it.

camp_npcs.name: Healer Muadhnait
camp_npcs.greet: Ceannai brews, carried up the south road. Coin, mind.

camp_npcs.name: Iasc's cousin Beag
camp_npcs.greet: Back to Connla? Down the river in an hour, if the eriu don't put a hole in us.

camp_npcs.name: Watch-Warden Cathal
camp_npcs.greet: The Sentinels hold the war-camp now. When the clans come back - and they will - I'll need every blade.
camp_npcs.idle: Watch the trees. The eriu don't charge. They're just suddenly there.

camp_npcs.name: Sentinel of Ceannai
camp_npcs.idle: First night in a month I haven't heard those totems chanting.
